steps: First-run setup and styled workspace
Excel file selected, checked and imported through the UI
Staff inquiry parsed, priced, saved and submitted
Boss inbox refresh and separate-account approval; staff status update
PDF and Excel downloaded; Malay approved reply copied
English and Malay UI labels and inquiry parsing
Missing specification blocks draft; 360px layout has no horizontal overflow
Synthetic WhatsApp page: one content-script button and selected-text message (Chrome runtime stubbed)
Message action captures customer and original, auto-parses missing spec, inserts clarification without sending
Incoming capture preserves unsaved work; explicit replacement and edited quantities survive reopening
Combined save and submit preserves the source on the real backend
Boss approval updates sidebar; approved Malay reply inserts once, logs draft only, and preserves existing composer text
Wrong chat is blocked; returning to the original visible message permits insertion
Chat action language follows sidebar language; 430px sidebar stays within viewport
Boss configures AI, verified phone recipient and HTTPS origin; credentials clear from the form
Staff has no settings access; structured extraction separates two products and the catalog computes RM413.75
Background outbox submits one template with the correct amount and scoped link; UI distinguishes acceptance from delivery
Separate phone context reviews only this quotation; wrong boss password cannot approve and is cleared
Malay mobile approval updates the staff workspace and downloads the actual generated PDF through the gateway
Mobile and settings layouts fit narrow screens; language labels switch; public gateway has no catalog route
Owner imports the complete business workbook with products, inventory, history, delivery and rules
Unbranded natural inquiry matches 85-stock fast cement and shows structured requirements, alternatives and RM471.20 recommendation
Minimum-margin violation is blocked; owner edits to 4% and RM30 then approves RM471.60 while the original recommendation remains
Actual PDF and Excel downloads use the approved amount; all three customer replies include the final discount and freight
Recording a won result and actual delivery cost changes the next recommendation to 9 similar orders and a 3.17% discount
Missing delivery area blocks submission, new labels switch across three languages and the 360px workflow fits without overflow
The real isolated mobile gateway supports Malay owner edits and approval, including a 320px layout; no external API or tunnel is used
Role-based home has one prominent new-quote action, accurate empty counts, two staff tabs and three owner tabs
Product and price steps show separately; quantity edits affect real prices and language switches preserve the recommendation
Back navigation retains products; a reloaded draft resumes the correct step and delivery area and requires source confirmation again
Changed inquiry is reparsed; cancelling a new-quote request preserves unsaved work and home can resume it
Owner approves the saved recommendation directly with edit fields, history reasons and return controls collapsed
Return reason is saved; home counts and filters use current approval and customer outcomes rather than calling approvals sales
All administration is grouped in owner settings; three languages fit 320px, 430px and desktop without horizontal overflow
1,020 stays 1020 and is blocked by stock; correcting the original inquiry to 20 produces a reviewed PDF and three replies
Two equal quantities remain two products through approval, PDF and all customer replies
Negated collection retains delivery and nonzero freight in the approved quotation and outputs
English and Chinese exclusions show their meaning and select valid alternatives through approval and generated files
A separate preference line attaches to its one product without creating a ghost item
A delayed response cannot advance changed inputs; changing 21 to 22 requires a fresh reason, preserved across languages and recorded on approval
Range quantity cannot become the last endpoint or be dismissed with a general confirmation; editing the inquiry restores pricing
Unknown goods on a delivery line stay visible; deleting them requires a specific cancellation and saved reason
A manually added product can be confirmed through its actual row and persists as two quotation lines with a correction reason
The owner sees the exact manual correction and reason in all three phone languages before approving; actual PDF contains both products and final price
A draft cached by the old parser preserves its original inquiry but must reparse instead of reusing obsolete correction IDs
After business data changes, the phone explains that a new review is required and disables approval while keeping return available
Reusing a phone tab adopts the new quotation link and ignores a delayed response for the previous quotation
